name: London Calling
description: Madame Vex has intelligence on a Vault-Tec substation buried beneath the old City of London financial district. The data inside could expose pre-war corporation ties to the bombs. She needs someone physically on-site to pull the cache.

stages.name: Reach the City of London
stages.description: Travel to the old financial district in the heart of London ruins.

stages.name: Locate the Vault-Tec Substation
stages.description: Search the ruins of the old financial district for the concealed Vault-Tec substation entrance. Madame Vex's coordinates put it beneath what was once a bank.

stages.name: Extract the Data Cache
stages.description: Access the substation terminal and extract the pre-war corporate data cache. Return to Madame Vex with the findings.
